title: Roaring 20s Simulator
description: Experience the advancement of the Roaring 20s, from spaceships to netherrite farms.
body:
This modpack contains very fun and interesting mods. Dive deep into Alex's caves and see all of his mobs AND etcetera, or dive upwards to Mars or the Moon with Ad Astra. If you're a little geek, build a diamond farm with the Create mod. Experience this and more just as those who lived it in the early 20th century, including Louis Armstrong and Albert Einstein. The possibilities are endless... or are they?

Yes, they are.
